name: climate-heat-monitoring
title: Where climate monitoring stops watching
description: An inventory of 46 operational digital climate-monitoring systems scored on whether their output is coupled to any actuator, a 15-stage map of gaps in the emission-to-harm chain, heat exposure indicators for twelve southern European cities from ERA5 reanalysis 1950–2025, and twelve costed interventions ranked by deployment burden.

sources.title: ERA5 hourly data on single levels, Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S)
Operational documentation for 46 monitoring systems; see notes_and_provenance

x_themes.title: Monitoring systems and gaps
x_themes.description: What is being watched, by whom, and whether anything happens when it detects a problem.

x_themes.title: Heat exposure, 12 cities, 1950–2025
x_themes.description: Indicators computed from ERA5 daily temperature reanalysis for twelve southern European cities.

x_themes.title: Actions and costs
x_themes.description: Twelve interventions with cost, evidence and what blocks a start, plus conventional benchmarks.

x_themes.title: Research attention
x_themes.description: Publication counts and a sample of highly cited works per theme, from OpenAlex.

resources.name: monitoring_inventory

resources.description: 46 operational digital climate-monitoring systems across 8 layers, each scored on resolution, latency, openness, funding and whether the output is wired to any actuator.

resources.name: gap_matrix
resources.title: Gap matrix: the emission-to-harm chain
resources.description: 15 stages from emission to health outcome, each scored 0–5 on how badly it is observed. Four stages score 5: effectively unmeasured.

fields.description: Delay between event and data.

fields.name: who_can_see_it
fields.description: Who has access to the data.

fields.name: coupled_to_action
fields.description: Whether observation at this stage triggers action.

fields.name: gap_severity_0to5

fields.name: evidence_for_the_gap
fields.description: Evidence and sources behind the score, including 2026 revisions.
